utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but could you tell me the time window and what supplies to bring so I can plan ahead?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on the exact time window, but I can bring duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves. I’ll drop them off before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that helps. Once you know the start and end time, can you let me know so I can plan the setup without scrambling?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard it’s set for Saturday morning, and folks are expecting a pretty good turnout this weekend. But that’s just what I picked up around the neighborhood, so it’d be smart to double-check with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll double-check with the organizers and keep spreading the word around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect, Quinn — and if I hear anything new from Marla or the organizers, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds doable—what time should I come by Saturday morning, and what do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Come by around 10 a.m. Saturday if that works, Nell. First thing, could you help me sort the tool requests as Mara sends them so I can match people with lenders?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, 10 a.m. works for me, Jules—I’ll help sort Mara’s tool requests first and keep them organized for the lenders.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, just a quick reminder that we’re still meeting Saturday morning for the repair drive — I’m checking in with everyone so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’m still in for Saturday morning — I’ll catch up as usual and take whatever small task needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Dane — I’ll let the others know you’re in, and we’ll sort out the small tasks when we meet Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you confirm the time and what needs repairing for the drive? I don’t want to guess before I help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only skimmed the note, so I don’t have the time or repair list yet. If you send me the basics, I’m good to go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the basics confirmed yet either, so I’ll check with Mara and send you the time and repair list once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira — thanks for checking in. I can send the repair drive details and let you know what help I still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa — can you confirm the date, time, and what supplies you still need? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details right.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — it’s Saturday morning at the community room, and I’ll send the exact time this afternoon. Right now, I still need help with check-in and labeling items.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Sam — the repair drive is set for Saturday at 10, and I’m bringing basic tools to start with the fence panel before we tackle the porch light.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll be there Saturday at 10 and can help with the fence panel and porch light. I’ll also bring a notepad to keep track of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Sam — a notepad will help a lot. See you Saturday at 10, and we’ll start with the fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve got Saturday at 10 a.m. penciled in for the repair drive, and I’ll check the school calendar before I spread the word to the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye—please confirm the school calendar first, then tell me if Saturday at 10 is definite and whether parents should bring broken items, spare parts, or both.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do—I’ll check the school calendar first, then confirm whether Saturday at 10 is definite and what parents should bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Opal — I think the repair drive is Saturday at 10, mostly for the loose fence panel and that stubborn porch light. If I’ve muddled that up, please remind me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Oren — Saturday at 10 sounds right. Is the meetup still by the community shed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, I think it’s by the community shed — thank you for checking. I’ll try to remember to point folks there Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly they need tools and a few hands to sort donations. I’ll keep asking around while I’m out and let you know if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good to know. I can bring a few tools Saturday morning if you need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Noah — I heard screwdrivers and packing tape are especially needed, and extra hands for carrying boxes would help too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the shed now for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves, Mara — Dane’s still short on the hammer and screws, and Rey said he can bring tape and gloves before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll note that Dane still needs a hammer and screws, and that Rey’s bringing tape and gloves. I’ll keep tracking the rest of the requests for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve checked the shed, and I’ll bring over any hammer or screws I find right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I’ve got a drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape I can bring—just tell me when you need them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that’s perfect. Can you come by at 10 and help sort tools for an hour?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll be there at 10 and help sort tools for an hour.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still set for Saturday morning for the repair drive, and I’ll keep reminding the others too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll send the final details to everyone today, and your reminders will keep us on track for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep nudging the others, and we’ll see everyone Saturday morning for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t seen the final setup yet, but I’ll check the notice board and ask around this morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — if you can find out the time window and whether we still need tables or extension cords, I can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll check on the time window and ask specifically about tables and extension cords, Pia. Once I hear something firm, I’ll let you know so we can keep the plan tidy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive today, though I’ll need to keep it brief. I can sort a few supplies before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds useful, Uli—Rosa told me they’ll need help with check-in and labeling Saturday morning, but I can pass along that you’re available briefly to sort supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Nell. Sorting supplies for a short stretch is about what I can manage, so please let Rosa know I’ll come by briefly Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right — I think we’re starting at 10 on Saturday, with the fence panel and that porch light. If I’ve mixed anything up, just remind me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm: 10 on Saturday, with the fence panel and porch light?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that sounds right — 10 on Saturday, with the fence panel and porch light. Thanks for double-checking me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly screwdrivers, packing tape, and a few people to carry boxes. If you can bring any of that, it’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m already bringing duct tape and gloves, and I can come a little early to help carry boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey — that covers a lot. Please come 20 minutes early if you can, and I’ll put you on box duty first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send any tool requests my way, and I’ll match people up and help with the handoffs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and pass along any tool requests I hear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Ira — just send me names and what they need, and I’ll connect them with someone who can lend it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape first. Just let me know what time works best for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — those will be really useful. I’m still confirming the repair drive date and time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it and add your tools to the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — just keep me posted, and I’ll be ready to bring the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape when the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking the shed for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves. What else are you short on for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A drill and a set of screwdrivers would still be really helpful, and any spare parts you find would be great.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll add a drill, screwdrivers, and any spare parts to my shed check, and I’ll bring over whatever I find right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Tess—I'm tracking the repair drive details, and so far the community shed looks like the meetup spot, but I still need to confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Opal, that matches what I’ve been hearing—Saturday morning at the community shed, though Marla only had it secondhand. I’d still check with the organizers before you put the time in stone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess—I’ll check with the organizers before I lock it in and keep the shed as the meetup spot for now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, Saturday morning still works for me. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Saturday morning it is — I’ll keep spreading the word and bring a few neighbors by too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, thanks, Quinn. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Faye, I’m planning to help Leo sort the donated tools for the repair drive—do you know if there’s anything else that needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, if you can help set up the tools and maybe check in volunteers, that would be a big help. We’re still aiming for Saturday at 10 a.m., so anything you can do around that time works well.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me—I’ll be there Saturday at 10 to help set up the tools and check in volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, sorry I’m late again — I’m still trying to round up a hammer and some screws, and Cleo may be checking the shed for tape and gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — before you go too far, I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the exact repair list and date, so hold the hammer and screws for now unless she’s already told you they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll hold off on the hammer and screws until Mara confirms. Just let me know the exact list when you have it, and I’ll catch up from there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
